theme.title: NBA Mix 34
theme.subtitle: Five moments from across NBA history
theme.recap: Five NBA stories, five different numbers: a quick tour of stars, teams, records and surprises.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 1993–94 Seattle SuperSonics win?
questions.note: 63 victories, before a shocking first-round elimination.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: league-best 63–19 record

funFacts.text: Seattle acquired two-time Sixth Man of the Year Detlef Schrempf from Indiana before the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: acquired All-Star forward, and 2-time Sixth Man of the Year Detlef Schrempf from the Indiana Pacers

funFacts.text: The Sonics also traded for Kendall Gill from Charlotte that offseason.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: acquired Kendall Gill from the Charlotte Hornets

funFacts.text: George Karl was chosen to coach the Western Conference's All-Star team.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: head coach George Karl was selected to coach the Western Conference

questions.prompt: The 1966–67 Sixers’ 50-game start is still tied for the best ever. How many of those 50 did they lose?
questions.note: Just four: 46–4. The 2015–16 Warriors later matched it.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 76ers started the season at 46–4, which remains the best 50-game start in the NBA history

funFacts.text: The 1966–67 start would eventually be matched by Golden State's celebrated 2015–16 regular season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: remains the best 50-game start in the NBA history (though tied in the Warriors 2015-16 season)

funFacts.text: Philadelphia ended Boston's streak of eight consecutive championships in the Eastern finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: defeated the Boston Celtics (a team that had won eight consecutive titles

funFacts.text: The Sixers first swept the Cincinnati Royals before dispatching their historic rivals in the next round.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In the 1st round of the playoffs, they swept the Cincinnati Royals

questions.prompt: The 1970–71 Bucks set what was then the NBA's longest winning streak. How many games?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This season included a 20-game winning streak, the NBA's longest at the time, and still ranked fifth all-time

funFacts.text: Larry Costello was Milwaukee's head coach during the championship run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Head coach  | Larry Costello

funFacts.text: The Bucks dispatched the Lakers in five games to win the Western Conference finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the team dispatched the Lakers in 5 games

funFacts.text: Milwaukee became the first franchise from the Midwest Division to claim an NBA championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Bucks became the first team from the Midwest Division to win the NBA title

questions.prompt: How many games behind first-place Boston did the 1972–73 Sixers finish in their division?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 76ers finished an NBA-record 59 games behind the Atlantic Division champion Boston Celtics.

funFacts.text: Only six seasons earlier, Philadelphia had set an NBA record for regular-season wins.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Only six seasons earlier, the 76ers had set the NBA record for most wins in a season

funFacts.text: Philadelphia's average scoring margin was an abysmal minus 12.1 points per game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: their −12.1 points per game point differential

funFacts.text: The struggling roster was playing its tenth season in Philadelphia.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: their 24th season in the NBA and tenth in Philadelphia

questions.prompt: How many points did Rik Smits score in Game 4 against the 1998 Bulls?
questions.note: 26 points in a dramatic two-point win.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: May 25, 1998 Chicago W 96–94 Smits (26)

funFacts.text: The Pacers won Game 4 by just two points at home.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: May 25, 1998 Chicago W 96–94

funFacts.text: Chris Mullin led Indiana with nine rebounds that night.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: May 25, 1998 Chicago W 96–94 Smits (26) Mullin (9)

funFacts.text: The Pacers won all three home games in that East final but none in Chicago.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Eastern Conference finals: 3–4 (home: 3–0; road: 0–4)
